IF EXISTS(SELECT table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.tables where table_name = 'STG_EDS_CRM_CATEGORIES' and table_schema = 'd360')
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE d360.STG_EDS_CRM_CATEGORIES;
END;

CREATE TABLE  [d360].[STG_EDS_CRM_CATEGORIES]
( 
    [H]	[varchar](max)	NULL,
	[BANK_ID] [varchar](8)  NULL,
	[CATEGORYID] [numeric](38,0)  NULL,
	[CATEGORYTYPE] [varchar](30)  NULL,
	[VALUE] [varchar](200)  NULL,
	[DESCRIPTION] [varchar](200)  NULL,
	[DEL_FLG] [varchar](1)  NULL,
	[FILE_NAME] [varchar](100)  NULL,
	[insert_dttm] [datetime]  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE,
	HEAP
)
